title: 3692. Majority Frequency Characters

examples.explanation: Frequency (k) Distinct characters in group Group size Majority? 4 {d} 1 No 3 {a, b} 2 Yes 2 {c} 1 No 1 {e} 1 No Both characters 'a' and 'b' share the same frequency 3, they are in the majority frequency group. "ba" is also a valid answer.
Frequency (k) Distinct characters in group Group size Majority? 1 {a, b, c, d} 4 Yes All characters share the same frequency 1, they are all in the majority frequency group.

Frequency (k) Distinct characters in group Group size Majority? 2 {p, f} 2 Yes 1 {g, i} 2 No (tied size, lower frequency) Both characters 'p' and 'f' share the same frequency 2, they are in the majority frequency group. There is a tie in group size with frequency 1, but we pick the higher frequency: 2.
